faqItems.a1: Absolutely safe. Your funds are always stored in your own exchange account. We only execute trades via API and cannot withdraw your funds. API permissions are limited to trading only, no withdrawal access.
faqItems.a2: Not at all! Our platform is designed for non-technical users. Just a few simple steps: create account, connect exchange, choose strategy, and start auto-trading.
faqItems.a3: We recommend starting with at least $100 to ensure the strategy has enough capital for proper position sizing. Some strategies may require more, check specific strategy details.
faqItems.a4: Investment involves risk, we cannot guarantee returns. However, our AI strategies are based on extensive historical backtesting with strict risk controls. We recommend using spare funds and diversifying.
faqItems.a5: Currently supports Binance, OKX, Bybit, Bitget and other major exchanges. More exchanges are being added.

faqItems.q1: How do I get started with Hoot?
faqItems.a1: To get started with Hoot, simply create an account, complete verification, then connect your exchange API. Our getting started guide will walk you through each step. You can add exchange API Keys on the Wallet page to connect your trading account.
faqItems.a2: Hoot supports major cryptocurrency exchanges including Binance, OKX, Bybit, Gate.io, Coinbase, etc. We continuously expand our supported exchange list. You can view the complete list on the Wallet > Exchanges page.
faqItems.q3: How do I set up exchange API Keys?
faqItems.a3: Go to your exchange account settings and create a new API Key. Make sure to only enable Trading and Read permissions, do not enable Withdrawal permission for fund safety. Then add your API Key on Hoot's Wallet > Exchanges page.
faqItems.a4: Hoot uses a profit-sharing model. Basic tier Gas Fee is 22% of profits, Advanced is 18%, Professional is 15%. Fees are only charged when strategies are profitable, no fees for losses.
faqItems.q5: How is my money kept safe?
faqItems.a5: Your funds are always stored in your own exchange account. Hoot never custodies user funds. We only execute trading instructions via API. We recommend enabling 2FA and not granting withdrawal permission to API Keys.
faqItems.a6: When a strategy generates a trading signal, the system automatically executes trades through your connected exchange API. You can set per-trade amount limits and risk parameters in strategy settings to ensure trades match your risk preferences.
faqItems.q7: How do I subscribe to membership?
faqItems.a7: Go to My Profile > Membership Subscription page and choose your membership tier. You can pay with USDT or HOOT tokens. Using HOOT tokens for payment gives you extra discounts.
faqItems.q8: How do I get help with issues?
faqItems.a8: You can contact support via email or live chat at the bottom of the page. Our support team will respond within 24 hours. For urgent issues, we recommend using live chat for immediate assistance.

modeInfo.soloDesc: A single AI model performs technical + derivatives data analysis on monitored coins each cycle, outputting trading decisions (direction, leverage, SL/TP) in one shot. Fast response, short decision chain — best for trending markets.
modeInfo.debateDesc: Multiple AI models independently analyze the same market data, each providing trading direction and confidence, then reach consensus through weighted voting. Cross-validation reduces single-model bias — best for ranging or unclear markets.
modeInfo.gridDesc: AI-driven grid trading strategy that automatically places limit buy/sell orders within a price range, profiting from price oscillations. Supports uniform/gaussian/pyramid grid distributions, with AI dynamically adjusting grid boundaries each cycle. Best for ranging markets.
